name: default_pr_without_review
rationale: Normal PR handoff must not request Codex review.

name: explicit_review_flag
rationale: Only --review opts into creating a Codex review request.

name: legacy_auto_review_ignored_without_flag
rationale: Legacy AutoCodexReview config remains parseable but must not trigger review.

name: unrelated_comment_with_review_flag
existing_comments: please ask @codex review after tests pass
rationale: An unrelated comment mentioning the command should not suppress the explicit review request.

name: marker_comment_with_review_flag
rationale: Existing Namba marker comments prevent duplicate review comments.
